claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke's failed-save outcome removes the creature outright. Existing effects cover damage, conditions, exile, and transformation, but not immediate destruction/death with remains handling.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: event_triggered_passive_operation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman's hostile-contact rider is a passive item effect that triggers on item contact and on the holder's end step. Passive operations currently only support elapsed-time cadence, not contact or turn-bound event triggers around an item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate_target_predicate_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke changes the target's save only when the chosen target is a Fiend or an Undead. The current save-gate surface has no way to express target-type-conditional advantage/disadvantage on that one resolving save.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.
